name: Delicate Instruments
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.
This is most frustrating, adventurer. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
narrative.objectives: Kill 6 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
narrative.offerRewardText: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, Chonk.
